text:
aisha_sales: Hey team — Acme POC wants a Dedicated endpoint with a single static outbound IP for allowlisting, hosted in eu-west-1. They need a demo next Wed. Can we confirm static egress options + any pricing delta? @jamie_netops
jamie_netops: We have two patterns: 1) Redwood-owned static EIPs in the VPC per pool (recommended), or 2) proxy through customer egress (customer-managed NAT). For eu-west-1 we can reserve EIPs. Do they need rotation?
acme_it: Prefer one outbound IP to allowlist. Rotation is ok but needs notice. Only port 443.
ravi_eng: Dedicated can front with static NAT EIP(s). Weekly rotation is possible but will break strict allowlists unless we provide a scheduled maintenance window. We can also add mTLS client certs for the Dedicated endpoint as an extra auth layer.
elena_security: Acme's questionnaire requires TLS1.3, AES-GCM, HSM-backed KMS for any key storage, and audit logs retention. They asked if logs/audit can be delivered to their S3. Also they want our SOC2 doc.
aisha_sales: I'll attach SOC2 and answer KMS Qs. @ravi_eng — can Dedicated push audit events to customer S3 (cross-account)?
ravi_eng: Yes — we support cross-account delivery to a customer-owned S3 via an IAM role. We'll need the bucket ARN and a write policy. I'll draft the trust role and config steps.
jamie_netops: Firewall guidance: allow outbound to our EIP(s) on 443. If they rely on DNS/SNI, they'll need to allow *.redwood-inference.com too — but for strict allowlist we hand them exact EIP(s). If they use ALB with SNI, we might require additional DNS entries.
acme_it: For initial smoke tests can we get temporary access that's easier to stand up before full Dedicated?
aisha_sales: Yes — we can issue short-lived Hosted API keys for smoke tests (non-isolated). Default TTL 72h; can extend for POC if needed. Then we swap to Dedicated once networking is in place.
acme_it: Can you give a cost estimate for Dedicated + static EIPs + 99% SLO for POC?
ravi_eng: Ballpark: Dedicated min commit + static IP add-on. I'll annotate the quote with expected vCPU/GPU hours for the demo. Sales should provide final numbers, but expect a small monthly uplift for static-egress and reserved capacity.
aisha_sales: Action items: 1) Acme to send CIDR(s) /32 list + S3 ARN by EOD Tue. 2) Jamie to confirm EIP count & NAT design. 3) Ravi to prepare cross-account role template and per-step config. 4) I will prepare a provisional quote and temp Hosted keys. :thumbsup:
jamie_netops: I can reserve 2 EIPs (active/standby) for redundancy, share the exact IPs after reservation.
deploy-bot: Reserved 2 EIPs in eu-west-1 for project-acme-poc (reservation id: rp-1234).
acme_it: Thanks — we'll send CIDR and S3 details shortly.

---

Note: cross-account trust snippet (example):
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodDeliveryRole"},
    "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
  }]
}
```

End of thread.
